question: Is M8 laundering money?
summary: No evidence that M8 is laundering money: its top-0.2% legacy score comes from 320 customers who each paid once, it shares no devices or IP addresses with other accounts and no money passes through within the hour.

findings.title: M8: high score, explained by ordinary activity
findings.detail: M8 is a merchant account: its legacy anomaly score ranks #1 (top 0.2%); 320 different senders, 100% of whom paid exactly once (ordinary customers); no incoming payment is passed on within an hour; outgoing settlements go to A101, held by the same customer.

findings.title: No shared devices or IP addresses
findings.detail: M8 shares no login infrastructure with any other account.

findings.title: Largest outgoing payment went to A101 and stopped there
findings.detail: $6,355 from M8 to A101; it was not passed on to anyone else within the hour.

findings.title: No pass-through activity
findings.detail: No payment entered and left M8 within 60 minutes for a similar amount.

receipts.cypher:
MATCH (c:Customer)-[:OWNS]->(a:Account {id: $id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[o:TRANSFER]->(r:Account)
WITH c, a, count(o) AS out_count, sum(o.amount) AS out_total, count(DISTINCT r) AS out_counterparties
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Account)-[i:TRANSFER]->(a)
RETURN a.id AS id, a.type AS type, a.status AS status, a.opened_at AS opened_at,
       a.country AS country, a.anomaly_score AS anomaly_score, c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS owner,
       out_count, out_total, out_counterparties,
       count(i) AS in_count, sum(i.amount) AS in_total, count(DISTINCT s) AS in_counterparties

MATCH (b:Account)
RETURN count(b) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN b.anomaly_score > $score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher

MATCH (s:Account)-[i:TRANSFER]->(a:Account {id: $id})
RETURN s.id AS sender, count(i) AS times, sum(i.amount) AS total

MATCH (a:Account {id: $id})-[:USED_DEVICE|USED_IP]->(x)<-[:USED_DEVICE|USED_IP]-(b:Account)
WHERE b.id <> $id
RETURN b.id AS account, labels(x)[0] AS via_kind, x.id AS via_id
ORDER BY account, via_id

CALL algo.WCC({nodeLabels: ['Account', 'Device', 'IPAddress'], relationshipTypes: ['USED_DEVICE', 'USED_IP']})
YIELD node, componentId
WITH node, componentId
WHERE 'Account' IN labels(node)
WITH componentId, collect(node.id) AS members
WHERE any(m IN members WHERE m IN $ids)
RETURN componentId, members

MATCH (a:Account {id: $id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(b:Account)
RETURN b.id AS dst, t.id AS id, t.amount AS amount, t.ts AS ts
ORDER BY amount DESC, ts DESC
LIMIT 1

MATCH (a:Account {id: $id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(b:Account)
WHERE t.ts > $after AND t.ts <= $until AND t.amount <= $max_amount AND t.amount >= $min_amount
RETURN b.id AS dst, b.type AS dst_type, t.id AS id, t.amount AS amount, t.ts AS ts
ORDER BY amount DESC, ts ASC

MATCH (a:Account)-[t1:TRANSFER]->(m:Account)-[t2:TRANSFER]->(b:Account)
WHERE m.id IN $ids
  AND t2.ts > t1.ts AND t2.ts - t1.ts <= $window_ms
  AND t2.amount <= t1.amount AND t2.amount >= t1.amount * (1.0 - $fee_tolerance)
  AND a.id <> b.id
RETURN a.id AS src, m.id AS via, b.id AS dst, t1.id AS in_id, t2.id AS out_id,
       t1.amount AS in_amount, t2.amount AS out_amount, (t2.ts - t1.ts) AS gap_ms
ORDER BY gap_ms ASC
LIMIT 50

proposed_actions.label: Close the alert as explained - no laundering evidence
